status_rule.entry: timed pitch with a scoreboard review and at least one confirmed field
status_rule.confirmed: reviewer's on-screen reading equals the recorded label
status_rule.mismatch: reviewer's reading differs from the label; reported as label_conflict, not evaluable
status_rule.unreadable: reviewer could not read that field in the decision frame; not evaluable
status_rule.occluded: no verified pre-delivery frame (timing status unavailable)
status_rule.scoreboard_unreviewed: timed pitch without a field-level scoreboard review
status_rule.no_confirmed_field: reviewed, but no field was both readable and equal to the label
status_rule.timing_unreviewed: manifest pitch without a timing row; counted in total_pitches only
